skill_name: List five benefits of a vegetarian diet.
workflow: There are many health benefits to a vegetarian diet. First, vegetarians typically have lower rates of obesity, heart disease, and certain forms of cancer due to a decreased consumption of saturated fats and processed meats. Second, a vegetarian diet can provide a variety of important vitamins and minerals that are found more abundantly in plant-based foods.
